column2: This campaign is meant to replace

I have designed in the last two years several different campaigns on the German/Axis side or the Soviet side. Most of the scenarios were East-Front fighting. Histo rically most of the heaviest action occurred in the East Front within the period covered by the campaign (late 1942 - late 1945). Most of the casualties in WWII occurred in the Russian front (3/5 of all others combined). Therefore, the scenarios were fu l l of fast pace and violent action. The fighting was also extremely violent and continuous. Recently Mr. Frank Chini presented a campaign that was a combination of Onward to Berlin and Defending the Reich with the player being the German side. He develo p ed a procedure to reverse the players' sides, i.e., if originally the player was the German and the AI was the Soviets, he reversed the order. This campaign gave me the idea of collecting my more than 40 East-Front Scenarios together with the SSI scenari os and preparing a Russian campaign by retooling all these scenarios.
column3: 过去两年里，我设计过若干不同的战役，有的在德国/轴心国一方，有的在苏联一方。大多数场景都是东线作战。从历史上看，在战役覆盖的时段（1942 年末至 1945 年末）内，最激烈的行动大多发生在东线。二战中的大部分伤亡都出现在俄国战线（相当于其余各线总和的三分之五）。因此，这些场景充满了快节奏和激烈的战斗。战斗也极为激烈而持续不断。最近 Frank Chini 先生推出了一个战役，它把《向柏林进军》和《保卫帝国》结合起来，玩家扮演德军一方。他开发出了一套颠倒双方阵营的流程，也就是说，如果原本玩家是德军、AI 是苏军，他就把顺序反转过来。这个战役让我想到：把我 40 多个东线场景与 SSI 场景收集起来，通过改造所有这些场景来制作一个俄国战役。

column2: This campaign has been designed to reflect fast pace, heavy and continuous action. In many s cenarios the player will be allowed to deploy only a fraction of its army. The auxiliary units are very important because they contribute to the balance of power and at the same time provide some sorely needed capabilities. At the same time the game bec o mes more realistic. Successful campaign play requires minimum casualties or you will be out pretty soon. This fact leads to neglect of the auxiliary units and excessive caution concerning the core units. Here you cannot neglect your auxiliary units. Y ou will need every single one of them or you will not win. I regularly reinforced them to keep them alive.
column3: 本战役的设计要体现快节奏、沉重而持续的战斗。在许多场景中，玩家只被允许部署其军队的一小部分。辅助单位非常重要，因为它们有助于维持力量平衡，同时提供一些急需的能力。与此同时，游戏也变得更真实。要在战役中打好，就必须把伤亡降到最低，否则你很快就会出局。这一事实会导致玩家忽视辅助单位，并对核心单位过分谨慎。在这里你不能忽视辅助单位。你需要它们中的每一个，否则就赢不了。我经常给它们补充兵员，让它们活下来。

column2: One interesting concept used in this campaign is the idea of "defensive scenarios." There are several of these scenarios in the campaign. The mai n idea is, the player does not have neither victory nor supply objectives. In order to win the player has to keep all the victory objectives held by him at the beginning of the game. If some are lost the player has to retake them to win. Of course, the game is over if the player loses all of them. Mr. Lasse Jensen originally proposed this idea. It was implemented using his excellent editor. You set victory conditions for both players on the same hexes and then you make sure that at least one of your v ictory hexes is lost. I found out that 3-4 victory scenarios are the best number. One or two are practically lost from the beginning, and the other one-two is/are under very heavy attack. If you set the AI to attack mode and give adequate reinforcement s you have a nice game. The lack of supply hexes is used to reduce the number of player units.
column3: 本战役采用的一个有趣概念是"防御型场景"。战役中有几个这类场景。其主要思路是：玩家既没有胜利目标，也没有补给目标。要获胜，玩家必须守住自己在开局时掌握的全部胜利目标。如果有目标丢失，玩家必须夺回才能获胜。当然，如果全部丢失，游戏就结束了。这个想法最初由 Lasse Jensen 先生提出。它借助他出色的编辑器得以实现。你在同样的格上为双方设置胜利条件，然后确保自己至少有一个胜利格会丢失。我发现 3-4 个胜利格的场景效果最好。其中一两个实际上从一开始就丢了，另外一两个则遭到极猛烈的攻击。如果你把 AI 设为攻击模式并给予足够的补充兵员，就会有一场不错的游戏。缺少补给格被用来减少玩家单位的数量。

column2: This campaign is not a historical campaign. I have a lot of respect for people who try to reproduce history, but this is mostly a fictional campaign. Everybody knows how things ended and it was a good thing. I designed a movement, heavy and continuous action campaign. You start fighting from the first term and it will not be over until is over. I sincerely regret if you do not like this kind of scenarios, but everybody is entitled to his own taste.
column3: 本战役不是历史战役。我非常尊重那些试图重现历史的人，但这个战役基本上是虚构的。大家都知道事情最终如何收场，而那是件好事。我设计的是一个运动战、沉重而持续的战斗战役。你从第一回合起就在战斗，不到结束不会停歇。如果你不喜欢这类场景，我由衷感到遗憾，但每个人都有权有自己的口味。

column2: The fictional character of the campaign makes you fight a battle approximately every two months. The period in between battles is even smaller by the end of the campaign. Of course , in practice this is impossible even when in some scenarios you can deploy only part of your army. There were many interesting battles in the last year of the war. Please allow for this designer's license.
column3: 战役的虚构性质使你大约每两个月就要打一仗。到战役末期，两场战斗之间的间隔更短。当然，实际上这是不可能的，即使在某些场景中你只能部署部分军队。战争最后一年有许多有趣的战斗。请容许设计者有这样的自由。

column2: This campaign is not an endorsement of any political idea or of war. War is one of the most regrettable human activities. Before discovering Panzerg2 I was a master level chess player. I see the game as a more "colorful" chess.
column3: 本战役不代表对任何政治理念或战争的赞同。战争是人类最令人遗憾的活动之一。在发现 Panzerg2 之前，我是一名大师级国际象棋棋手。我把这个游戏看作一盘更"多彩"的棋。

column2: I have organized implicitly the two armies following th ese guidelines. The two armies are distributed in Corps, infantry and tank corps. A tank corps has 4-6 units, 3-4 are tanks the others are auxiliaries (anti-tanks, AD, etc.). Each infantry corps has 4-8 units. At least 3 are infantry units, the others are artillery, anti-tanks, AA, AD, etc. Every unit represents a division or division-like formation. Two Russian armies will eventually participate, the 3
column3: 我按照以下准则隐含地组织了两支军队。两支军队按军编成，分为步兵军和坦克军。一个坦克军有 4-6 个单位，其中 3-4 个是坦克，其余是辅助单位（反坦克、对空防御等）。每个步兵军有 4-8 个单位。至少 3 个是步兵单位，其余是炮兵、反坦克、高射炮、对空防御等。每个单位代表一个师或类似师的编队。最终将有两支俄国集团军参战，第 3
